detailed_description: The EXIF Viewer reads metadata from one uploaded JPEG, JPG, or TIFF image in the browser. Choose an image file, review the preview and extracted tag table, and see common fields such as camera make, model, timestamps, exposure settings, image size, orientation, GPS fields, software, artist, and copyright when they are present. The Remove EXIF action redraws the image to a canvas and prepares a JPEG copy for download with a _no_exif filename. The tool does not support PNG EXIF parsing, batch uploads, selective tag removal, a hex editor, WebAssembly processing, original-format preservation, or WebP export.
usage_steps: Choose one JPEG, JPG, or TIFF image file from the upload area.
Wait while the browser loads the file and ExifReader parses available tags.
Review the image preview, file name, extracted tag table, and field count.
Click Remove EXIF to redraw the image on a canvas and create a JPEG copy.
Click Download Clean Image when the cleaned JPEG copy is ready.
Use Clear to reset the page before checking another image.
usage_examples: Inspect whether a camera photo contains make, model, timestamp, or GPS fields.
Create a JPEG copy after redrawing an uploaded image through the browser canvas.
Check how many metadata fields ExifReader can display for a local JPEG sample.
Clear the current file before reviewing another image.
